g.text: Skybound brake response — actual game model
Calm air · 98.55 kg · 26 m² · fixed 240 Hz ticks · 60 s descent · density changes with altitude
Not measured wing data, a safety assessment, or a headset capture. Whiskers: full 240 Hz final 10 s range.
Actual 10 Hz trace; sink range -0.97 to 9.07 m/s
Actual 10 Hz trace; sink range -2.31 to 11.15 m/s
Green: within declared variation thresholds. Orange: unsettled. These labels do not establish normal or safe flight.
Example: full brake at 1,500 m has low variation but almost vertical motion and very high incidence.
